text.en: 1. This Order is the Interpretation (Delegations by Minister for Education) Order 2024 and comes into operation on 1 March 2024.

2. The Minister for Education, with the Prime Minister’s approval, delegates the functions under the provisions of the Acts specified in the first column of the Schedule to the persons specified in the third column of the Schedule, subject to the conditions (if any) specified in the fourth column of the Schedule.
